mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EOS_RESOURCE WHERE DISPOSE_YN = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EOS_RESOURCE WHERE DISPOSE_YN = 'N' AND RISK_GRADE_CD = #{riskGradeCd}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EOS_RESOURCE WHERE DISPOSE_YN = 'N' AND EOS_STATUS_CD IN #{s}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EOS_RESOURCE WHERE DISPOSE_YN = 'N' AND RISK_GRADE_CD IN ('CRITICAL','HIGH') AND EXCEPTION_ACTIVE_YN = 'N' AND RESOURCE_ID NOT IN ( SELECT RESOURCE_ID FROM TB_EOS_ACTION_PLAN WHERE STATUS_CD NOT IN ('DONE') )
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RESOURCE_ID) FROM TB_EOS_ACTION_PLAN WHERE STATUS_CD IN ('PLANNED','IN_PROGRESS','TESTING')

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT r.RESOURCE_ID, r.RESOURCE_NAME, r.RISK_GRADE_CD, r.EOS_STATUS_CD, l.EOS_YMD, ROWNUM rn FROM TB_EOS_RESOURCE r LEFT JOIN TB_EOS_PRODUCT_LFC l ON l.VERSION_ID = r.VERSION_ID AND l.EFFECTIVE_TO_DTM IS NULL WHERE r.DISPOSE_YN = 'N' ORDER BY CASE r.RISK_GRADE_CD WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, l.EOS_YMD ASC ) WHERE rn <= #{limit}
SELECT POLICY_VAL FROM TB_EOS_POLICY WHERE POLICY_TYPE_CD = 'KPI_FORMULA' AND POLICY_KEY = 'RISK_STATUS' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND EFFECTIVE_TO_DTM IS NULL FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
